items.anonymous_evidence_summary: 该学生自述平时包含一次访谈作业和考勤，期末为闭卷并在结课后提供复习提纲；课程涉及政体、投票和政党等基础主题。学生认为课堂讲解结合故事较易跟进，并提到考试需要把提纲展开成材料分析。文中报告个人成绩为 A-，属于单人经历。

items.anonymous_evidence_summary: 学生形容课程覆盖面较广、课件内容多且教师讲授速度快。其自述完成一篇不超过约 3000 字的指定书目读书笔记，反馈关注学术规范；期末考试范围广且不划重点，需要较多复习。文中对课程整体有正面评价，同时认为它不适合只求低投入的选课者。
items.mapping_status: historical exact title + teacher; current roster has two course codes with the same title and teacher, so the historical source code cannot be assigned to one current course code
items.adoption_status: adopt as historical course-and-teacher reference only; do not assign to a specific current course code or class
caveats: Some assessment details in the source are reported from a single student's experience or hearsay.

items.anonymous_evidence_summary: 学生报告阅读与笔记投入较大，课程文献覆盖经典及前沿理论；课堂节奏集中，建议边听边整理材料。学生认为内容难度较高但能带来积累，并描述了讨论、期末考试和实地访谈报告。文中提及个人取得 A 的经历，但不构成总体给分证据。
items.mapping_status: historical exact title + teacher; unique current title-and-teacher match in the official roster
items.adoption_status: adopt as historical reference for the same teacher and course title; not current-term evidence
caveats: The review contains strong subjective commentary; the summary retains course logistics and the reviewer's self-reported experience, not allegations about the instructor.

items.source_title: 收获满满！老师和助教都好！（23春学期）
items.anonymous_evidence_summary: 该学生高度认可课程把古希腊文本与现实议题相联系的讲授方式。其回忆包括前八周围绕《伯罗奔尼撒战争史》的阅读、学生章节导读、戏剧讨论课、小组展示和论文；提到阅读量较大，但讨论任务相对集中于小组展示。
items.mapping_status: historical exact title + teacher; unique current title-and-teacher match in the official roster
items.adoption_status: adopt as historical reference with an unresolved date conflict
caveats: Catalog index says 2021/S3, while the review title says 2023 spring; preserve both and do not normalize the date.

items.source_title: 老师和助教都是大好人
items.anonymous_evidence_summary: 学生描述正课包含章节导读、教师专题讲解和论文指导，讨论课包含戏剧阅读与小组展示；其回忆每周阅读一个章节，认为不强制阅读，但参与阅读更有帮助。学生称对古希腊史初学者也较友好，并报告个人论文成绩经历。
items.mapping_status: historical exact title + teacher; unique current title-and-teacher match in the official roster
items.adoption_status: adopt as historical reference; not current-term evidence
caveats: Grade details are a single student's report, not a distribution.

items.source_title: 浇灭人任何热情的一节课
items.anonymous_evidence_summary: 与其他同课评价形成明显分歧：该学生对授课风格和观点表达有强烈负面感受，并报告自己投入了大量阅读和论文准备；其描述课程考核涉及阅读、展示和论文，认为投入与学习体验不匹配。摘要不复述针对教师的未核实指控。
items.mapping_status: historical exact title + teacher; unique current title-and-teacher match in the official roster
items.adoption_status: adopt as contrasting historical student perspective; not current-term evidence
caveats: This is one strong negative report; compare with other student experiences and do not treat allegations as verified facts.
